## About
The Pet Wellness Clinic is a family owned and operated hospital in Magnolia. We started it because it's tough to know where to turn when your dog or cat isn't feeling well, and we wanted one place where your pet can get everything he or she needs.
Dr. Don is a graduate of Texas A&M University and school of Veterinary Medicine, and he's a certified Animal Nutritionist. He believes the key to a long, happy life is prevention: regular vaccinations, a healthy diet and natural, yet effective supplements.
Ginger, our best friend, waits by the door to greet you, and the good stories and hot coffee are always flowing. Our clients rate us 4.5 from 120 Google reviews.

## Services
- Routine Care: Routine checkups and much needed vaccinations to keep your pet healthy and strong.
- Preventive care: From diet to natural supplements, Dr. Don can help keep your pet healthy. As the saying goes, an ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure.
- Surgical suite: When time is of the essence, we have a full service surgical suite for those critical times.
- Nutrition: Dr. Don is a certified Animal Nutritionist who specializes in pet nutrition, so your best friend stays healthy and visits us less often.
- In-house pharmacy: Prescriptions are filled right here while you wait.

## FAQ
Q: What should I bring to my first visit?
A: You can download our new client information sheet from our website and have it filled out before you come in. We want your first visit to be a pleasant one.

Q: Who do I call in an emergency?
A: Our contact page lists an emergency phone line with Dr. Quillivan, DVM.

Q: Can you see my pet the same day?
A: A reviewer whose dog had a ruptured anal gland wrote that Doc got them in as a walk in the same day. Give us a call and we'll let you know what we can do.

Q: Do you work with clients on payments?
A: A reviewer wrote that we worked with her on payments. Please ask us about it when you call.

Q: What are your Wednesday hours?
A: Our Wednesday hours are shorter: 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM.
